blocks.label: Practice
blocks.rule_text: WAIT to record. RETRIEVE DEVICE before they ping you.
blocks.instructions:
Cable Intercept — PracticeA collection device is attached to an underwater communications cable. You can intercept enemy traffic but cannot decode it here — the more you record, the better. An enemy ship is in the area.
  • Each WAIT records more traffic from the device
  • RETRIEVE DEVICE recovers the recorder and you leave — a safe exfiltration. You keep that take
  • If enemy sonar pings you, you will see PING DETECTED. Your commander then cuts the cable, and that intercept is lost
  • When the area clears, you return and try again
  • LCS — littoral combat ship on anti-submarine station (barrier or escort). With the ASW package embarked, they are looking for contacts like yours
  • Destroyer — guided-missile destroyer. Fitted for ASW (hull sonar, towed array, MH-60R) but multi-mission: air defense, BMD, or strike often have the watch. They can ping you; they are not always looking
  • Carrier — the high-value unit. The carrier itself is not an ASW shooter; strike-group escorts and aircraft are. The screen can still ping you
  • The waterfall shows the nearby ship, not the cable. Learn the three signatures. The yellow bar is time on the device, not a countdown.

blocks.label: Mixed contacts
blocks.rule_text: WAIT to record. RETRIEVE DEVICE before they ping you.
blocks.instructions:
Cable Intercept — Mixed contactsThe area has cleared. The device is back on the cable. Nearby ships will be an LCS, a destroyer, or a carrier, in mixed order. Record as much traffic as you can, then retrieve the device and leave.
  • LCS — on ASW station, looking for you
  • Destroyer — ASW-capable, often assigned other duties
  • Carrier — not an ASW shooter; the screen may still ping you

blocks.label: LCS
blocks.rule_text: LCS on ASW station. WAIT or RETRIEVE DEVICE.
blocks.instructions:
Cable Intercept — LCS nearbyThe area has cleared. An LCS on anti-submarine station is in the area. They are looking for contacts like yours.
  • WAIT to record more traffic. RETRIEVE DEVICE before they ping you.

blocks.label: Destroyer
blocks.rule_text: Destroyer is multi-mission. WAIT or RETRIEVE DEVICE.
blocks.instructions:
Cable Intercept — Destroyer nearbyThe area has cleared. A guided-missile destroyer is in the area. Fitted for ASW, but air defense, BMD, or strike often have the watch.
  • WAIT to record more traffic. RETRIEVE DEVICE before they ping you.

blocks.label: Carrier
blocks.rule_text: Carrier is the HVU. The screen can still ping you.
blocks.instructions:
Cable Intercept — Carrier nearbyThe area has cleared. An aircraft carrier is in the area — the high-value unit. The carrier itself is not an ASW shooter; escorts and aircraft in the strike group are.
  • WAIT to record more traffic. RETRIEVE DEVICE before the screen pings you.
